GSAP — self-hosted vendor copy for Surface C (/wy/)
====================================================

version: 3.15.0
source:  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.15.0/dist/<file>
fetched: 2026-07-26
license: GreenSock Standard License — https://gsap.com/standard-license
         (free for the use made here: a non-commercial personal site with no
         paid-membership plugins. Only the three no-charge files below are
         vendored. Club plugins — DrawSVG, SplitText, ScrollSmoother,
         MorphSVG, CustomEase — are NOT present and are NOT used.)

files:
  gsap.min.js            72927 B raw   28314 B gzip -9
  ScrollTrigger.min.js   44575 B raw   17982 B gzip -9
  Flip.min.js            25534 B raw    9706 B gzip -9

availability probe run before pinning (task requirement):
  3.15.0 200
  3.14.0 200
  3.13.0 200
-> 3.15.0 is the newest confirmed-200 3.x and is the version shipped.

loading contract
----------------
All three files are UMD. Their wrapper is:

    !function(t,e){ "object"==typeof exports && "undefined"!=typeof module ? e(exports)
                  : "function"==typeof define && define.amd ? define(["exports"],e)
                  : e((t=t||self).window = t.window || {}) }(this, function(e){ … })

Inside an ES module `this` is undefined and neither `exports` nor `define`
exists, so the third branch runs: `t = self`, and the factory writes onto
`window`. Therefore `import '../vendor/gsap/gsap.min.js'` is a legal
side-effect import that publishes `window.gsap`; ScrollTrigger and Flip then
self-register (`La() && Fe.registerPlugin(ne)` / `window.gsap &&
window.gsap.registerPlugin(pt)` — see the tail of each file). Static import
order is specified by the language, so gsap.min.js always evaluates first.
`e.default` is deleted when the export object IS `window`, so a default
import would be `undefined` — always use the side-effect form plus the
global, exactly as js/surface-c.js does.

Flip.min.js is loaded with a DYNAMIC import from js/surface-c.js, not a
static one. It is only needed when the lightbox is first opened, and moving
its 9,706 gzip bytes out of the first view is what keeps Surface C inside the
52 KB gzip JS budget (28314 + 17982 = 46,296 B for gsap + ScrollTrigger).

NOT vendored on purpose: ScrollSmoother. It creates a transformed ancestor,
which breaks position:fixed and content-visibility — the exact bug class this
refactor exists to remove.

do not hotlink
--------------
The live page previously loaded GSAP 3.9.1 from cdnjs in the parent document
AND gsap@3 from unpkg.co / unpkg.com inside two iframes: three runtimes, two
versions, zero cache sharing, ~206 KB doing the work of one 109 KB copy.
These three files replace all of that.
